dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Disaster! Disaster! At a recent public exhibition, the Babich Automated Analysis Engine suddenly exploded in a shower of gears, causing great injury and death to onlookers!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Mr. Babich himself was severely injured and remains unconscious!

dialogues.speaker: Sir Arthur
dialogues.text: Analysts' Guild President Marco Borja has opined that this tragedy was nonetheless an inevitable step on the path to progress, and that the Guild expresses its deep sympathies and condolences.
